intent: Jumps feel floatier and more natural: a gentler gravity gives a slower rise and fall, and a player who lands keeps some of their sideways momentum and skids on instead of stopping dead.
accept: Rise and fall are visibly slower than before, with a smooth arc
After landing while moving sideways, a player keeps drifting in that direction for a few ticks that fade out
Every platform in the tower is still reachable by a jump (tests pass)
The same inputs always give the same result (determinism test green)
